## Description
A brief description of what this PR does and why it is needed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🌐 Localization / Translation update
- [ ] 🧹 Code cleanup / Refactor / Performance improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`./dev.sh lint` passes with 0 warnings/errors).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`./dev.sh test` passes).
- [ ] If I changed user-facing strings, I ran `./dev.sh pot` to update the gettext catalog.
- [ ] I have tested this change on an e-ink device or in the KOReader emulator.
